in_sanskrit.name: Bangaru
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Blessed with wealth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bangaru एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Bangara’ which means ‘bull’. The name ‘Bangaru’ is a respectful title given to a wealthy or prosperous man in Indian culture. It is believed that a person named Bangaru is blessed with wealth and prosperity throughout their life.
